content.value: Standard crankshaft diameter of a Hino bus= 1 OOmm 12 Standard bearing clearance = 0.1 mm Standard journal bearing size= 99.9mm Wear limit= 0.2mm After three years operation of the bus, the engine is checked for major repairing and following parameters are found; Crankshaft diameter= 99.98mm Journal bearing diameter= 99.9mm Tapemess and ovalness are within acceptable limit. Find out; (i) Available life of the bearing and crankshaft and (ii) Do you suggest to use the bearing (old) or new with the reason thereby?
